content.text:
Updated the package to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md` and corrected the README entries for `flags_in_window` and `daily_flag_counts`.

The package-wide review also fixed parser error messages to report the original input line number, group rankings to exclude empty groups and break ties by name, per-group rates to preserve the specified key order, and streaks to reset on nonpositive counts.

Added regression tests confirming that `None` counts as unflagged and that the last input record wins for duplicate IDs, even when it has an earlier day. All 20 tests pass with `python -m pytest -q`.
